body: Seems like a bug in `count()`. It should detect that the finder is complex enough to choose another counting strategy.
matching() doesn't feed into the 'complex' check in Query::count(). Only group/distinct/union do. Perhaps the presence of matching clauses should too.
The actual problem is the sub query in select.
